本轮最重要的发现:**快照里两个最高分 head 的「偏度」在数值上不是偏度,整个 M2 家族是规则 §4 陷阱 1。** 依据三条链:
(1) 源码 — alphacube/operators/common.py:43 EPS=1e-9,nanskew_last 返回 m3/(std³+EPS),是绝对 epsilon;rolling_pair_reduce 的 corr 同样是 cov/(sqrt(var·var)+EPS)。
(2) 本机算术(只用随机张量)— day_durbin_watson(Open) ≈ day_std(Ret)²(比值 1.004,日度秩相关 0.997),即波动控制日度原料的平方,量级 ~1e-6;在 1e-4 及以下的输入上 ts_skew 的输出与 m3×1e9 四位有效数字完全相同,归一化被 EPS 完全摧毁。于是 ts_skew(DW(Open),50) 是 σ 的 6 次齐次量,双层是 18 次,外面那个「3 日自相关」实际是 cov×1e9、再翻一倍到 36 次。
(3) 真实数据的独立确认 — 定位输出里 ts_skew(ts_skew(DW(Open),50),50) 的 coverage 恰好塌到 0.8708(门槛废品),而 nanskew_last 唯一的 NaN 出口是 std>EPS 这道闸,这正好钉住内层输出量级 ≈1e-9,反推 day_std(Ret)≈0.1%/分钟,与 A 股完全吻合。
凸度阶梯与分数的对应是陷阱 1 的指纹:次数 2 → −2.13;6 → +1.18/+1.23;18 → 门槛废品;36 → +1.56。方向都是 −1,多头腿 = 已实现方差最小的那一端,即低波动异象的多头腿;它躲过中性化靠凸性,躲过不合格判定靠「已知族量的是成交额离散而不是波动」(rho_known 仅 0.19–0.20)。模拟进一步显示 50 日 m3 与窗口内 max 的秩相关 0.992、与均值 0.937,而与真正归一化的偏度只有 0.277;在一个形状被构造成无截面信息的世界里,它照样按波动水平把股票排了出来(秩相关 +0.92)。

由此得到两条可执行结论:**DW 家族不能当 E 核心**(预测它与波动控制的 |ρ| 0.55–0.85 ≥ 0.5,会被「核心是控制的伪装」直接判成普通 GP,白费一次审计),**只能走 R**;R 的 A 组(ts_skew(log(DW(Open)),50)、自归一化版、ts_std(log(...)),加一条显式的 cross_mean(pow_3(DW(Open)),50) 作对照)是本轮信息量最大的几次评估,我押诚实版 < 0.5 而显式凸性版 ≥ 1.1。

It is the only head off the back-adjusted price axis, the only one never dissected, and has the lowest valid/train ratio (1.36). The window evidence (10/30/60 -> +0.03/+0.12/+0.67) says it is a slow trait. K mixes real shape variation with the estimator's own sampling noise (fat tails, tick discreteness). The periphery has four parts, all new since K had none: (1) VOV scale normalization, div(K, 60-day mean or median |skew|), after Baltussen et al. 2018; (2) normalization by the square root of mean kurtosis, which also tests whether K only reads 'no jump minutes'; (3) K as a measurement-quality gate: cs_first_low20 / cs_last_high20 pools ranked inside by low realized skew (the Amaya direction; Amaya et al. use 5-minute data and exclude low prices for the same reason) or by low normalized MAX (Bali et al.); (4) control seeds that rank K within deciles of nominal price and of zero-return-minute share. No price, size or amount levels, no convex transforms. OOS case: slow variable, low turnover, a cross-market VOV effect, and the head does not depend on the 2022-23 style. 12 seeds.

Closing-session price pressure reverses. Head +0.58 buys stocks whose volume comes early in the day (-2*day_centroid(sqrt(Volume)), enrichment +0.93, p 0.007). Non-informational pressure from passive/ETF and institutional rebalancing concentrates in the last 30 minutes and the closing auction (Bogousslavsky-Muravyev), as do closing-price manipulation and window dressing (Hillion-Suominen 2004, Comerton-Forde-Putnins 2011, Carhart et al. 2002). Flow-driven pressure reverts over weeks (Coval-Stafford 2007). Single-day deviations mostly revert overnight, before the label's 09:31-09:45 VWAP entry, so the seeds use only 10-60 day aggregates. Operators: close vs the daily VWAP log(div(day_last(Close), day_wmean(Vwap, Amt))), as mean, median, t-stat and intraday-vol-standardized versions; the last-30-minute return via in_delay(Close, 30); the last-30-minute turnover share via is_gt(in_index(Amt), 0.875), where 0.875 is the bar 211-240 boundary; that share times the close deviation; and the turnover centroid with its abnormal shift. Seeds are negated, so the long book holds names pushed down at the close. slots.hypothesis: Core is the daily intraday money-flow tilt: (Amt-weighted minute return minus equal-weighted minute return) / intraday std. It is the kernel of the only clean head (+0.61, valid +2.61, sign +1). That head has only been grown with pure time smoothing ({cross_mean}, {cross_ema}). The level of the tilt mixes a stable per-stock intraday composition (open/close U-shape, closing-auction share; the r1 auditor's competing explanation) with real flow information. The new peripheries leave smoothing and use five families. (1) Abnormal tilt relative to the stock's own history (GKM 2001), which removes the persistent composition part by construction. (2) Cross-day Amt-weighted minus equal-weighted tilt, plus covariance with the amount z-score (busy days vs normal days). (3) A per-stock informativeness term, cross_corr(lagged tilt, daily return, 120), alone and times the recent tilt (LMSW 2002 classification; Easley et al. 2002). (4) Persistence and continuity: autocorrelation-weighted tilt (Chordia-Subrahmanyam 2004 order splitting) and a frog-in-the-pan rank difference (Da-Gurun-Warachka 2014). (5) Tail asymmetry and tilt relative to the day's direction. No powers of volume or volatility and no cs_* fed a cross-sectional constant. 13 seeds are kept deliberately far from the +0.61 head to avoid the |rho|>=0.7 strike. Direction is left to the reward. Why it should last out of sample: the head is stronger in valid than in train; order splitting, T+1 and short-sale limits are structural; every periphery is a per-stock relative quantity.

Overnight vs intraday tug of war (Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019, Berkman et al. 2012, Qiao-Dam 2020 on the A-share T+1 overnight discount, Jiang-Luo-Ye 2023-05, Aboody et al. 2018). Retail decisions after the close and at the opening auction set the overnight segment; institutions set the intraday segment. Which segment a stock's recent return came from says who is pushing the price, which the 20-day reversal control cannot see because it is the sum of the two segments. Operators: r_on = log(open / previous close) and r_id = log(close / open). They give (1) overnight drift scaled by the stock's own volatility (20/60-day mean, EMA, and 5-day minus 60-day abnormal overnight return); (2) cs_bucket_rank of the overnight mean within same-total-return deciles, orthogonal to reversal by construction; (3) per-stock tug-of-war strength via cross_corr / cross_regbeta of r_on against r_id, and yesterday's r_id against today's r_on; (4) where price discovery happens: overnight share of absolute moves, the overnight/intraday volatility ratio, and the signed opening-auction amount share. All terms are scale-free. None is a level or power of a control, and none feeds a constant to cs_*. No head reads a time split of returns, and the +1.53 head uses only the opening-price level as a top-10% flag. Direction is left to the reward. Why it should last out of sample: it comes from institutions and investor clienteles (T+1, call auctions) that did not change after the sample. Known risk noted: the 2018-08 SSE closing-auction reform.
